sources.title: Sims Limited Welcomes Sixth Women Leading @ Sims Cohort
sources.excerpt:
A new short film preserves firsthand memories of September 11 and the recovery effort from people connected to the operations and communities that later became part of Sims Metal. Twenty-five years after September 11, the memories remain vivid for those who experienced the day firsthand.
